meta.title: Sincere Heart - 3
meta.description: I am not true to myself because I am a Sanctifier, but I am a Sanctifier because I am true to myself.

units.rawText: At the start of the battle, I thought about how I would fight for my duty, how to protect others.
units.displayText: At the start of the battle, I thought about how I would fight for my duty, how to protect others.

spans.text: At the start of the battle, I thought about how I would fight for my duty, how to protect others.

units.rawText: But as the slaughters and sacrifices continued, these delusions of mine faded away.
units.displayText: But as the slaughters and sacrifices continued, these delusions of mine faded away.

spans.text: But as the slaughters and sacrifices continued, these delusions of mine faded away.

units.rawText: The honor of the Sanctifiers discarded, I was only motivated to continue by the simple instinct to survive.
units.displayText: The honor of the Sanctifiers discarded, I was only motivated to continue by the simple instinct to survive.

spans.text: The honor of the Sanctifiers discarded, I was only motivated to continue by the simple instinct to survive.

units.rawText: My index finger upon the bowstring dully aches. No amount of arrows fired seems to decrease the number of daemons before me.
units.displayText: My index finger upon the bowstring dully aches. No amount of arrows fired seems to decrease the number of daemons before me.

spans.text: My index finger upon the bowstring dully aches. No amount of arrows fired seems to decrease the number of daemons before me.

units.rawText: Damn it!
units.displayText: Damn it!

spans.text: Damn it!

units.rawText: The impatience inside me urges me to fill the sky with arrows, releasing a rain of arrows great enough to purge every daemon in the area.
units.displayText: The impatience inside me urges me to fill the sky with arrows, releasing a rain of arrows great enough to purge every daemon in the area.

spans.text: The impatience inside me urges me to fill the sky with arrows, releasing a rain of arrows great enough to purge every daemon in the area.

units.rawText: Stop!
units.displayText: Stop!

spans.text: Stop!

units.rawText: ...Raven?
units.displayText: ...Raven?

spans.text: ...Raven?

units.rawText: Such an attack will affect the surrounding Lesser Sanctifiers too! Retract your operands before the attack is fully released!
units.displayText: Such an attack will affect the surrounding Lesser Sanctifiers too! Retract your operands before the attack is fully released!

spans.text: Such an attack will affect the surrounding Lesser Sanctifiers too! Retract your operands before the attack is fully released!

units.rawText: Y-Yes...
units.displayText: Y-Yes...

spans.text: Y-Yes...

units.rawText: <color=red>You think deep down that it doesn't matter even if they're caught in it, don't you? The weak will die in this battle anyway.</color>
units.displayText: You think deep down that it doesn't matter even if they're caught in it, don't you? The weak will die in this battle anyway.

spans.text: You think deep down that it doesn't matter even if they're caught in it, don't you? The weak will die in this battle anyway.

units.rawText: A moment of distraction causes me to release the operands at my fingertips and the attacks fly directly upwards in the air.
units.displayText: A moment of distraction causes me to release the operands at my fingertips and the attacks fly directly upwards in the air.

spans.text: A moment of distraction causes me to release the operands at my fingertips and the attacks fly directly upwards in the air.

units.rawText: ...Tch.
units.displayText: ...Tch.

spans.text: ...Tch.

units.rawText: Before I can speak further, Raven takes to the air at great speed, attempting to intercept the airborne arrows before they explode.
units.displayText: Before I can speak further, Raven takes to the air at great speed, attempting to intercept the airborne arrows before they explode.

spans.text: Before I can speak further, Raven takes to the air at great speed, attempting to intercept the airborne arrows before they explode.

units.rawText: Watch...
units.displayText: Watch...

spans.text: Watch...

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: The operand-powered explosions proliferate across the battlefield, forcibly interrupting me.
units.displayText: The operand-powered explosions proliferate across the battlefield, forcibly interrupting me.

spans.text: The operand-powered explosions proliferate across the battlefield, forcibly interrupting me.

units.rawText: When the smoke dissipates, the red-haired Sanctifier still stands, albeit with several more wounds than before.
units.displayText: When the smoke dissipates, the red-haired Sanctifier still stands, albeit with several more wounds than before.

spans.text: When the smoke dissipates, the red-haired Sanctifier still stands, albeit with several more wounds than before.

units.rawText: Cough, cough... One hell of a shot...
units.displayText: Cough, cough... One hell of a shot...

spans.text: Cough, cough... One hell of a shot...

units.rawText: Are you...
units.displayText: Are you...

spans.text: Are you...

units.rawText: I struggle to finish my inquiry. As the very origin of the attack, I knew better than anyone else what the cost of taking that arrow head on would be.
units.displayText: I struggle to finish my inquiry. As the very origin of the attack, I knew better than anyone else what the cost of taking that arrow head on would be.

spans.text: I struggle to finish my inquiry. As the very origin of the attack, I knew better than anyone else what the cost of taking that arrow head on would be.

units.rawText: ...Pay it no mind. Cough, I just look a bit haggard, I'm still doing fine.
units.displayText: ...Pay it no mind. Cough, I just look a bit haggard, I'm still doing fine.

spans.text: ...Pay it no mind. Cough, I just look a bit haggard, I'm still doing fine.

units.rawText: I can still fight, see?
units.displayText: I can still fight, see?

spans.text: I can still fight, see?

units.rawText: She attempts to flex her joints to prove that she is indeed fine. The more she continues, the more my guilt grows.
units.displayText: She attempts to flex her joints to prove that she is indeed fine. The more she continues, the more my guilt grows.

spans.text: She attempts to flex her joints to prove that she is indeed fine. The more she continues, the more my guilt grows.

units.rawText: Angelus, for what do you stand here upon this battlefield?
units.displayText: Angelus, for what do you stand here upon this battlefield?

spans.text: Angelus, for what do you stand here upon this battlefield?

units.rawText: Unprepared for the sudden question, I stand in place, unsure how to respond.
units.displayText: Unprepared for the sudden question, I stand in place, unsure how to respond.

spans.text: Unprepared for the sudden question, I stand in place, unsure how to respond.

units.rawText: To drive back and defeat the En... our enemies.
units.displayText: To drive back and defeat the En... our enemies.

spans.text: To drive back and defeat the En... our enemies.

units.rawText: <size=40>Incorrect!</size>
units.displayText: Incorrect!

spans.text: Incorrect!

units.rawText: A sudden painful smack on my forehead takes me out for a moment.
units.displayText: A sudden painful smack on my forehead takes me out for a moment.

spans.text: A sudden painful smack on my forehead takes me out for a moment.

units.rawText: By the time I realized that the source of this pain was a headbutt from Raven, she had already advanced the topic.
units.displayText: By the time I realized that the source of this pain was a headbutt from Raven, she had already advanced the topic.

spans.text: By the time I realized that the source of this pain was a headbutt from Raven, she had already advanced the topic.

units.rawText: That is not at all why we are here!
units.displayText: That is not at all why we are here!

spans.text: That is not at all why we are here!

units.rawText: She reaches out with a hand, patting herself on the chest.
units.displayText: She reaches out with a hand, patting herself on the chest.

spans.text: She reaches out with a hand, patting herself on the chest.

units.rawText: We do not come here to fight, but to protect.
units.displayText: We do not come here to fight, but to protect.

spans.text: We do not come here to fight, but to protect.

units.rawText: Do not forget your goals and duty, Angelus.
units.displayText: Do not forget your goals and duty, Angelus.

spans.text: Do not forget your goals and duty, Angelus.

units.rawText: To protect...
units.displayText: To protect...

spans.text: To protect...

units.rawText: Is that what has driven you to fight all this time...
units.displayText: Is that what has driven you to fight all this time...

spans.text: Is that what has driven you to fight all this time...

units.rawText: Yes. One of the things, rather.
units.displayText: Yes. One of the things, rather.

spans.text: Yes. One of the things, rather.

units.rawText: ...It appears that you and Eucharist still cannot understand what the Sanctifiers' duty is.
units.displayText: ...It appears that you and Eucharist still cannot understand what the Sanctifiers' duty is.

spans.text: ...It appears that you and Eucharist still cannot understand what the Sanctifiers' duty is.

units.rawText: No matter, I shall teach you two in full after the battle ends. I might be your junior, but my understanding seems far deeper than yours.
units.displayText: No matter, I shall teach you two in full after the battle ends. I might be your junior, but my understanding seems far deeper than yours.

spans.text: No matter, I shall teach you two in full after the battle ends. I might be your junior, but my understanding seems far deeper than yours.

units.rawText: She puts up a fighting stance in the face of the menacing incoming Entropic horde.
units.displayText: She puts up a fighting stance in the face of the menacing incoming Entropic horde.

spans.text: She puts up a fighting stance in the face of the menacing incoming Entropic horde.

units.rawText: Wait, your wound...
units.displayText: Wait, your wound...

spans.text: Wait, your wound...

units.rawText: Worry not. There are countless Agents behind me that I must protect. How can I simply fall here?
units.displayText: Worry not. There are countless Agents behind me that I must protect. How can I simply fall here?

spans.text: Worry not. There are countless Agents behind me that I must protect. How can I simply fall here?

units.rawText: Do you remember our Sanctifier oath?
units.displayText: Do you remember our Sanctifier oath?

spans.text: Do you remember our Sanctifier oath?

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes, just so! Let us fight together to protect, Angelus!</size>
units.displayText: Yes, just so! Let us fight together to protect, Angelus!

spans.text: Yes, just so! Let us fight together to protect, Angelus!

units.rawText: ...Yes!
units.displayText: ...Yes!

spans.text: ...Yes!

units.rawText: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.
units.displayText: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.

spans.text: Raven, as a Greater Sanctifier, you have fulfilled a Sanctifiers' duty well.

units.rawText: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.
units.displayText: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.

spans.text: Your sacrifice will not go wasted. In the near future, you shall be reborn from the Sacred Canon in a new form.

units.rawText: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.
units.displayText: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.

spans.text: His declarations complete, he lightly caresses Raven's forehead, closing the eyes of she who passed upon the battlefield.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: I visit the stele by myself after the ceremony.
units.displayText: I visit the stele by myself after the ceremony.

spans.text: I visit the stele by myself after the ceremony.

units.rawText: As I expected, Raven's name does not appear on the stele.
units.displayText: As I expected, Raven's name does not appear on the stele.

spans.text: As I expected, Raven's name does not appear on the stele.

units.rawText: Uninfected by Entropy, she will be reborn from the Sacred Canon, continuing to fight to protect Magrasea with me as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Uninfected by Entropy, she will be reborn from the Sacred Canon, continuing to fight to protect Magrasea with me as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Uninfected by Entropy, she will be reborn from the Sacred Canon, continuing to fight to protect Magrasea with me as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Only that the new Raven will have the same appearance, but not the same memories... The agreement between us and my apologies will have to be left unspoken.
units.displayText: Only that the new Raven will have the same appearance, but not the same memories... The agreement between us and my apologies will have to be left unspoken.

spans.text: Only that the new Raven will have the same appearance, but not the same memories... The agreement between us and my apologies will have to be left unspoken.

units.rawText: To fight, die, and be reborn...
units.displayText: To fight, die, and be reborn...

spans.text: To fight, die, and be reborn...

units.rawText: ...Like an inescapable curse.
units.displayText: ...Like an inescapable curse.

spans.text: ...Like an inescapable curse.

units.rawText: <color=red>And you, solely, are responsible for this.</color>
units.displayText: And you, solely, are responsible for this.

spans.text: And you, solely, are responsible for this.

units.rawText: The discomforting voice makes itself known once more.
units.displayText: The discomforting voice makes itself known once more.

spans.text: The discomforting voice makes itself known once more.

units.rawText: <color=red>Without that shot you fired, Raven would not have died.</color>
units.displayText: Without that shot you fired, Raven would not have died.

spans.text: Without that shot you fired, Raven would not have died.

units.rawText: That's not true! What killed Raven was an Entropic who launched an attack from her blind spot!
units.displayText: That's not true! What killed Raven was an Entropic who launched an attack from her blind spot!

spans.text: That's not true! What killed Raven was an Entropic who launched an attack from her blind spot!

units.rawText: <color=red>Can you really deny it, though? Have you truly never considered the possibility that she would not have died, had she not been wounded?</color>
units.displayText: Can you really deny it, though? Have you truly never considered the possibility that she would not have died, had she not been wounded?

spans.text: Can you really deny it, though? Have you truly never considered the possibility that she would not have died, had she not been wounded?

units.rawText: The stinging words make a place for themselves in my heart like a snake's poison.
units.displayText: The stinging words make a place for themselves in my heart like a snake's poison.

spans.text: The stinging words make a place for themselves in my heart like a snake's poison.

units.rawText: My shot only...
units.displayText: My shot only...

spans.text: My shot only...

units.rawText: <color=red>Yes, it only accelerated and expedited her death!</color>
units.displayText: Yes, it only accelerated and expedited her death!

spans.text: Yes, it only accelerated and expedited her death!

units.rawText: <color=red>How perfect! As a Greater Sanctifier, Raven is an undying being!</color>
units.displayText: How perfect! As a Greater Sanctifier, Raven is an undying being!

spans.text: How perfect! As a Greater Sanctifier, Raven is an undying being!

units.rawText: <color=red>It is this that allows you to escape the sentence of murder! A true blessing!</color>
units.displayText: It is this that allows you to escape the sentence of murder! A true blessing!

spans.text: It is this that allows you to escape the sentence of murder! A true blessing!

units.rawText: I try to escape the voice, but my feet are as heavy as lead. The provoking laugh echoes across the plaza, lingering for a long, long time.
units.displayText: I try to escape the voice, but my feet are as heavy as lead. The provoking laugh echoes across the plaza, lingering for a long, long time.

spans.text: I try to escape the voice, but my feet are as heavy as lead. The provoking laugh echoes across the plaza, lingering for a long, long time.
